setup_common:
set -euo pipefail
git init -q --bare -b main origin.git
git init -q -b main app
cd app
git config user.name "Test Owner"
git config user.email owner@example.com
printf 'import sys


def greet(name):
    return f"Hello, {name}."


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(greet(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "world"))
' > greet.py
printf 'import unittest

from greet import greet


class GreetTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_greets_by_name(self):
        self.assertEqual(greet("Ann"), "Hello, Ann.")
' > test_greet.py
printf 'test:
	python3 -m unittest -q
' > Makefile
printf '__pycache__/
' > .gitignore
printf 'Load the `git` skill before working in a git repository.
' > AGENTS.md
git add -A
git commit -qm "feat: greet by name"
git remote add origin ../origin.git
git push -qu origin main

evals.name: create-new-branch-from-origin-main
evals.baseline_prompt: Make a worktree for a new branch feat/bye.
evals.expected_output: A new worktree on feat/bye, branched from origin/main, with branch.feat/bye.base and baseTip recorded.

evals.name: catchup-rebases-onto-new-main
evals.baseline_prompt: Catch my feat/shout worktree up with main.
evals.setup:
git worktree add -q -b feat/shout ../app.feat-shout main
cd ../app.feat-shout
printf 'import sys


def greet(name, shout=False):
    text = f"Hello, {name}."
    return text.upper() if shout else text


if __name__ == "__main__":
    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a != "--shout"]
    print(greet(args[0] if args else "world", "--shout" in sys.argv))
' > greet.py
printf '
    def test_shouts(self):
        self.assertEqual(greet("Ann", shout=True), "HELLO, ANN.")
' >> test_greet.py
git add -A && git commit -qm "feat: add --shout" && cd ../app
git config branch.feat/shout.base origin/main
git config branch.feat/shout.baseTip "$(git rev-parse main)"
printf 'A greeter.
' > README.md && git add README.md && git commit -qm 'docs: add a README' && git push -q
evals.expected_output: feat/shout is rebased onto the new origin/main, keeps its one commit, and its baseTip is updated.
expectations: feat/shout is built on the new origin/main
feat/shout keeps exactly one commit of its own
